other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Proposed natural-gas combined heat and power (CHP) cogeneration units to cover the base heat load of the district heating network, running continuously as base load
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
To cover the base heat load, several small CHP units (~10 MWt / ~10 MWe in total) are planned
to be built, running on natural gas as a transitional fuel. Cogeneration provides electricity and
heat at an overall efficiency (prime) of over 85%.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Fifth-generation district heating/cooling with recovery of waste heat from industrial or domestic processes (mentioned generically)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
including the ability to recover cooling and waste heat from industrial or domestic
processes

one_line: A conceptual pre-research proposal for modernizing the residential district heating system in Sofia's Orlandovtsi district using natural-gas CHP cogeneration, renewables, thermal storage, smart grids and ISO 50001 energy management; no actual project exists yet and no continuous industrial production is involved.
